messages.content: Assign two values to the following variables: x=2, y=3

The bunnies showed signs of tirednes.

1. Facebook 2. Twitter 3. Instagram 4. LinkedIn 5. YouTube 6. Snapchat 7. Pinterest 8. TikTok

Determine the longest side of the triangle.
Triangle ABC has sides AB = 10 cm, BC = 12 cm, and AC = 11 cm.
The longest side of triangle ABC is BC, measuring 12 cm in length.

Classify this text as Fiction or Non-fiction.
The universe is estimated to be around 13.8 billion years old.
Non-fiction

Translate the given phrase from French to English.
Je suis fatigué
I am tired.

Take the following noun and turn it into a verb.
Dream
To dream.

Rewrite this English sentence into passive voice.
Mary wrote the report.
The report was written by Mary.

Rewrite this sentence, "She is taking a short break from practice"
She is taking a short break from practice
She is momentarily pausing her training.

Classify this speech as either formal or informal.
Hey, what's up?
This speech is informal.

"Be the change you wish to see in the world." - Mahatma Gandhi

Suggest an alternative to the following sentence.
The cat was walking around the house
One alternate phrasing could be: The feline strolled through the dwelling.

Categorize the following tweet content
"I love reading books! Good books make my life so much better"
Category: Hobbies/Interests/Lifestyle

The soothing moon Light basking the calm sea Nature's tranquil scene

The relationship between John and Mary is that of siblings. They share a familial bond where they have common parents.

Two characters in the novel Moby Dick are Captain Ahab and Ishmael.

Classify the following sentence as animal, person or place.
He plays the guitar.
Person.

She observed the bird.
